description: This C# source file defines the FavoritesController class, which manages HTTP endpoints related to favoriting articles in a web application. It handles POST and DELETE requests for adding or removing articles from favorites, utilizing MediatR to send commands and enforcing authorization schemes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller managing favorite article actions, utilizing dependency injection for IMediator, and providing endpoints protected by authorization.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add an article to favorites using its slug, sending an Add.Command via MediatR.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove an article from favorites using its slug, sending a Delete.Command via MediatR.
